functions.name: uid
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
  )::uuid
$function$

functions.name: jwt
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.jwt()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
    coalesce(
        nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim', true), ''),
        nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')
    )::jsonb
$function$

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ select coalesce((auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'role') = 'admin', false); $function$

functions.name: is_staff
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_staff()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select public.is_admin() or exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid() and p.role in ('teacher', 'admin')
  );
$function$

functions.name: mfa_ok
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mfa_ok()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select auth.uid() is null
      or coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'aal', '') = 'aal2'
      or not exists (
        select 1 from auth.mfa_factors f
        where f.user_id = auth.uid() and f.status = 'verified'
      )
$function$

functions.name: my_student_ids
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_student_ids()
 RETURNS uuid[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(array_agg(s.id), '{}'::uuid[])
  from public.students s where s.auth_user_id = auth.uid();
$function$

functions.name: my_group_ids
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_group_ids()
 RETURNS uuid[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct s.group_id), '{}'::uuid[])
  from public.students s where s.auth_user_id = auth.uid() and s.group_id is not null;
$function$

functions.name: my_taught_group_ids
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_taught_group_ids()
 RETURNS uuid[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(array_agg(g.id), '{}'::uuid[])
  from public.groups g where g.created_by = auth.uid();
$function$

functions.name: my_course_ids
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_course_ids()
 RETURNS uuid[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(array_agg(c.id), '{}'::uuid[])
  from public.courses c
  where c.created_by = auth.uid()
     or exists (select 1 from public.course_shares cs
                 where cs.course_id = c.id and cs.teacher_id = auth.uid())
     or c.student_ids && public.my_student_ids()
     or c.group_ids   && public.my_group_ids()
     or exists (select 1 from public.course_enrollments e
                 where e.course_id = c.id
                   and e.student_id = any (select unnest(public.my_student_ids())::text))
     or exists (
       select 1 from public.students s
       where s.group_id = any (public.my_taught_group_ids())
         and (s.id = any (c.student_ids)
           or s.group_id = any (c.group_ids)
           or exists (select 1 from public.course_enrollments e2
                       where e2.course_id = c.id and e2.student_id = s.id::text))
     );
$function$
